stories.title: Mother sues Las Vegas police over fatal shooting of 3-year-old during standoff
stories.summary: The mother of 3-year-old Kentre Baker is suing Metro, alleging officers used excessive force and failed to de-escalate the standoff in which he was killed.

stories.title: Raiders hope to shore up key aspect of special teams after ‘not ideal’ disaster in Denver
